scope: Corollary 8.1 (Absence of a full-domain local first variation) of the manuscript “A Coulomb ground-state density without Kohn-Sham ensemble representation” (preprints/A-Coulomb-Ground-State-Density-without-Kohn-Sham-Ensemble-Representation-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 278 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5a9d714fd656a2c9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the physical ground-state density n = nΨ of Theorem 1.1, ∂VTens[n] = ∅. Moreover, there is no w ∈ V such that, for every m ∈ D, lim t↓0 EHxc[n + t(m − n)] − EHxc[n] t = ∫︂ R3 w(m − n). (8.1)
